text: Earlier in my experiments, I made the mistake of directly smelling ozone gas during a psychedelic state. It intensified the experience and became mentally alarming. DMSO didn't help that situation, while aged ozonated-charcoal water helped rapidly. I don't recommend inhaling ozone. The mistake suggested that DMSO and aged ozonated-charcoal water address different kinds of overload.
